cc:Work.dc:title: grep versus Trace: text matches and complete definitions
cc:Work.dc:description:
Real captured commands on the same pinned source. grep is a word-search excerpt, not a complete-source request or matched performance benchmark. Trace shows two complete requested definitions. Captured from an earlier tested build. Call counts are static graph evidence, not execution. Data is syntax-only, with unknown runtime binding. Seven selected grep matches from 50 matching lines across 14 files. Both Trace definition spans are complete: App.redirect, lines 939–958, and request_finished, line 11. Monospace code, STIX headings, thin rules, vibrant accents; pure-black dark background. Syntax coloring and header wrapping are presentation only. src/flask/sansio/app.py:App.redirect · lines 939–958 · method · 1 caller · 1 call 939 | def redirect(self, location: str, code: int = 303) -> BaseResponse: 940 | """Create a redirect response object. 941 | 942 | This is called by :func:`flask.redirect`, and can be called 943 | directly as well. 944 | 945 | :param location: The URL to redirect to. 946 | :param code: The status code for the redirect. 947 | 948 | .. versionchanged:: 3.2 949 | ``code`` defaults to ``303`` instead of ``302``. 950 | 951 | .. versionadded:: 2.2 952 | Moved from ``flask.redirect``, which calls this method. 953 | """ 954 | return _wz_redirect( 955 | location, 956 | code=code, 957 | Response=self.response_class, # type: ignore[arg-type] 958 | )
src/flask/signals.py:request_finished · lines 11–11 · data · syntax-only; runtime binding unknown · 1 binding definition 11 | request_finished = _signals.signal("request-finished")
